info.title: API.SH: Zoopla
info.description: The Zoopla API from API.SH: public Zoopla data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An estate agent branch: name, address, postcode, coordinates, website, opening hours, memberships, description, contact page url, sale and rental statistics (listing counts, average price, weeks on market) and its current listings (up to 10 for sale and 10 to rent, with price, bedrooms, bathrooms, address and photo). With `location` instead, the agents in an area (25 per page) with their listing counts and average asking prices. Branch phone numbers are business lines.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zoopla-agent

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Branch page url (https://www.zoopla.co.uk/find-agents/branch/<name>-<id>/).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Branch id as in the url (`<name>-<id>`).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Area to list agents in, e.g. london or oxfordshire/oxford.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of agents with `location` (default 1); `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Sold house prices in a UK town, area, district or postcode district: address, postcode, coordinates, last sold price and date, property type, tenure, bedrooms, bathrooms, living rooms and floor area, 25 per page, plus the area (county, region, postcode districts) and its average prices. Zoopla counts at most 10,000 results per search (`total_capped`); narrow with filters to reach older sales. With `include=history` each property also carries `sale_history` (every recorded sale: date, price, change and change percent since the previous sale), `listing_history`, `sale_history_source`, `epc_rating` and `energy` (current energy rating, often null) and `has_estimate`. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zoopla-sold

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place as in Zoopla house-price URLs (oxford, london, manchester, ox4, oxfordshire/watlington).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Zoopla /house-prices/<place>/ URL instead of location.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Property type.

parameters.name: sold_within_months
parameters.description: Sold in the last N months.

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: Minimum bedrooms.

parameters.name: max_beds
parameters.description: Maximum bedrooms.

parameters.name: baths
parameters.description: Minimum bathrooms.

parameters.name: max_baths
parameters.description: Maximum bathrooms.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default newest sale first).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `history` adds each property's full sale history and energy rating (slower: one extra lookup per property).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (1-400); pass `next_page` back.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
